By those bribe he bought a piece of land in about 20 years ago. Now hazrat is it permissible to eat or utilize for other purposes from this rental earnings? if it is rquired to do Sadka, will we have to do the purchasing price of the land or the current price or including the price of the rooms majority of which were built from money of provident fund? answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 42253 Country: Pakistan Title: Oil used for cooking food in non-muslim countries Question: You are in a restaurant to eat food in a non-Muslim country, you order fish but you are not sure which oil is used for cooking (vegetable oil or oil of some animal etc) you ask that if its Halal or Haram but you cannot get a reply. And this happens to you in almost all restaurants you visit, should you take that fish or not? Will it be halal or not? In some restaurants in non-Muslim country it is written Halal but at the same time they also serve Haram food, you are not sure if they speak the truth or not, in that case can you take the food or not? Will it be halal? Answer ID: 42253 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2137/1700/B=1433) If one is not sure rather has some doubt then one should not eat it. He should eat only the bread with some other thing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
